name: Thermostatic expansion valve (TXV)
control_behavior: Modulates refrigerant flow to control evaporator superheat.
v2_rule: For residential AC, manufacturer procedures commonly use subcooling; use equipment target/nameplate.

name: Fixed orifice / piston
control_behavior: Fixed restriction; superheat varies with load and operating conditions.
v2_rule: For residential AC, manufacturer procedures commonly use target superheat tables.

name: Capillary tube
control_behavior: Fixed restriction used in critically charged small systems.
v2_rule: Use equipment-specific charge/service data; do not apply TXV charging logic.
